# 0003. Finish the whole Template before the gift registry

Date: 2026-09-28 · Status: accepted

## Context
The Template's likely finish (about Nov 23) was after the gift registry's Nov 15 target for the user's sister's page, which only needs Template phases 1–3. The options were a gift-app break after phase 3, a standalone page, cutting Template scope, or moving the gift date.

## Decision
Finish all of the Template's v1 first, with no cuts and no break, because every future app is built from it. The gift registry's date moves (new date not set yet). The Template no longer has a fixed deadline; its target date is in ROADMAP.md.

## Alternatives
- Gift break after phase 3, with an Oct 31 fallback to a standalone page: meets Nov 15 but leaves export and delete unfinished while a real user is on the app.
- Cut Template scope to finish before Nov 15: weakens the base every app inherits.

## Consequences
SPEC §1 (Time) and ROADMAP.md were updated. The weekly check now measures against the ROADMAP target instead of Nov 16.
